children: Titagarh Rail Systems share price will remain in focus on October 29 after the company received an additional order worth Rs 1,716.90 crore from the Ministry of Railways.
The order is for manufacture and supply of 4,955 BOXNHL and BCNAHSM1 wagons with total quantity of 9,994 units.
The additional order will be executed at the same price of the original contract taking the total amended contract value to Rs 10,404.10 crore.
Catch all the market action on our live blog

A meeting of the board of directors of the company is scheduled to be held on October 29, 2026, to consider and approve unaudited financial results (standalone & consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026.
In the previous trading session, the share closed at Rs 692.40, up Rs 38.95, or 5.96 percent.
The share touched a 52-week high of Rs 970.05 and a 52-week low of Rs 568.65 on 18 June, 2026 and 30 March, 2026, respectively.
Currently, the stock is trading 28.62 percent below its 52-week high and 21.76 percent above its 52-week low.
The market capitalisation of the company stands at Rs 9,324.81 crore.

title: Titagarh Rail Systems shares in focus on order win from Ministry of Railways
